item.title: Trump turns 2020 statue wars on their head with Columbus monument revival
item.summary: A 13-foot Christopher Columbus replica now stands on White House grounds, replacing the monument rioters tossed into Baltimore's Inner Harbor in 2020.

item.title: Jet fuel prices soar as airlines warn supplies could run dry within weeks
item.summary: Soaring jet fuel prices tied to Middle East tensions have airlines warning of higher airfares and potential flight cancellations in the weeks ahead.

item.title: Schumer clashes with MS NOW host over whether degrading Iranian military is a good thing
item.summary: Sen. Chuck Schumer clashed with Joe Scarborough on Monday over whether degrading Iran's military is a good thing, as Schumer argued gas prices and recession risks matter more.

item.title: GOP candidate warns Bernie-backed Dem rival’s green ties could hit farms, energy
item.summary: Republican Rep. Derrick Van Orden frames Cooke’s environmental group endorsement as threat to Wisconsin agriculture and energy costs in battleground race.

item.title: LaGuardia plane crash video shows jet collide with fire truck after frantic air traffic control warning
item.summary: Released video shows an Air Canada jet striking a Port Authority fire truck at LaGuardia, killing both pilots and injuring dozens of passengers onboard.

item.title: SEE IT: 'Habitual' offender with 10-plus prior convictions arrested after driving backwards on highway: police
item.summary: A Florida man caught driving backwards on SR 100 claimed a mechanical issue before deputies arrested him for habitual driving with a suspended license.

item.title: Jessie J rushed to hospital over fears of broken neck during tour
item.summary: Jessie J was rushed to the hospital after smashing her head into a car roof during her No Secrets tour in China, saying she thought she broke her neck.

item.title: Veteran CBS reporter joins far-left media company MeidasTouch as anchor, says they share same 'north star'
item.summary: Ex-CBS News reporter Scott MacFarlane announced on Monday that he is joining far-left MeidasTouch, which is openly hostile to President Donald Trump.

item.title: Pritzker breaks silence on migrant charged in student’s murder, blames Trump for ‘politicizing’ case
item.summary: Illinois governor responds days after Loyola freshman’s killing, deflects to Trump while sidestepping questions on immigration enforcement

item.title: Critic slams Chicago's 'revolving door' as Loyola student killing sparks outrage
item.summary: Sheridan Gorman's family demands accountability after the Loyola University student's murder, calling it preventable and rejecting the explanation of "wrong place, wrong time."
